description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Ingredients class, which encapsulates business logic for handling ingredient data structures related to dishes and recipes, including methods for data transformation and editor support.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Ingredients
classes.description: A class providing business logic for handling ingredient data structures, including conversion to array references and editing functionalities.

methods.name: build_project
methods.description: Builds and returns the associated project object from the ingredients.

methods.name: as_arrayref
methods.description: Converts the ingredients into an array reference of plain data hashes, including associated articles and units.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares ingredient data for editing, including convertible units and article details.
